info.title: pdf-signer API
info.description:
HTTP wrapper around the `maxco-pdf-signer` library: applies a visible signature stamp and a
PKCS#7/CMS detached cryptographic seal to a PDF in one call.

Only the local PKCS#12 signing path (Path A) is exposed over HTTP. The remote-HSM path
requires a caller-supplied signing callback and is available through the library only.

The intended flow is two calls: POST /api/v1/documents/inspect to learn the page
geometry a stamp rectangle has to be expressed against, then POST /api/v1/sign to
stamp and seal. Authenticate with the `x-api-key` header on every `/api/v1` route.

apiKeyAuth.name: x-api-key
apiKeyAuth.description: Shared secret configured as the API_KEY environment variable on the server. Required on every /api/v1 route. Compared in constant time; a mismatch returns 401.

ErrorCode.description: Stable machine-readable error identifier. Branch on this rather than on the message text.

error.description: Human-readable description. Not stable — do not parse.
error.example: Invalid appearance: svgString must include a viewBox attribute

field.description: Dotted path to the offending field, or "(body)" for a whole-body issue.

details.description: Present only on VALIDATION_ERROR: one entry per failed field.

ErrorResponse.description: Standard error envelope returned by every non-2xx response.

error.example: PKCS#7 (17004 bytes) exceeds placeholder (16384 bytes). Set placeholderSizeBytes >= 17516.

actualBytes.description: Size of the assembled PKCS#7 container.

allocatedBytes.description: Size of the /Contents placeholder it did not fit into.

SignatureOverflowResponse.description: Returned when the certificate chain is larger than the allocated /Contents slot. Retry with metadata.placeholderSizeBytes set to actualBytes + 512 or higher.

signingDate.description: Signing time embedded in the PKCS#7 signedAttrs and the /M entry. Defaults to the server clock.

placeholderSizeBytes.description: Size of the /Contents slot in bytes. Raise this if signing fails with SIGNATURE_OVERFLOW. Rough guide: single certificate 3-4KB, three-certificate chain 10-14KB.

subFilter.description: Signature /SubFilter. Use ETSI.CAdES.detached for eIDAS/PAdES contexts.

svgString.description: A complete SVG document. MUST contain a viewBox attribute — the renderer requires it. Mutually exclusive with `text`.
svgString.example: <svg viewBox="0 0 300 80" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M10,60 C40,10 80,10 120,60" stroke="#000" fill="none" stroke-width="2"/></svg>

text.description: Text rendered in the bundled Great Vibes script font. Mutually exclusive with `svgString`.

color.description: CSS color for text mode. Default #1a1a2e. Ignored when svgString is used.

renderScale.description: Rasterisation scale factor relative to the stamp size. Default 2.

SignatureAppearance.description: Visual stamp definition. Provide exactly one of `svgString` or `text`.

x.description: Distance from the LEFT page edge, in `units`.

y.description: Distance from the page edge named by `origin`, in `units`. With the default origin (bottom-left) this is measured UPWARD from the bottom — the PDF convention, opposite to a browser.

origin.description: Which page corner `y` is measured from. Default "bottom-left" (PDF convention). Use "top-left" for a value taken straight from a browser, and the server flips it against the real page height. Cannot be converted on a page with a non-zero /Rotate.

units.description: Unit of x/y/width/height. Default "pt" (PDF points, 1/72 inch). Use "px" for a rectangle measured in pixels over a rendered page, together with viewportWidth or viewportHeight. Cannot be converted on a page with a non-zero /Rotate.

viewportWidth.description: Pixel width of the rendered page the rectangle was measured against — e.g. pdf.js `page.getViewport({ scale }).width`. Required with units:"px" unless viewportHeight is given. Only valid with units:"px".

viewportHeight.description: Pixel height of the rendered page the rectangle was measured against. Interchangeable with viewportWidth; when both are sent they are cross-checked against the page aspect ratio. Only valid with units:"px".

StampPosition.description: Stamp placement. By default in PDF points with a bottom-left origin — A4 is 595.28x841.89, Letter 612x792, Legal 612x1008; call POST /api/v1/documents/inspect for the actual page sizes. Set `origin` and `units` to send the rectangle in the space it was measured in (a browser gives top-left pixels) and the server converts it against the real page geometry. The rectangle actually used is returned in the X-Stamp-Rect response header.

pdf.description: The PDF to sign. Rejected with 413 above the server MAX_UPLOAD_MB limit.

metadata.description: JSON-encoded SigningMetadata object, sent as a form field value.

appearance.description: JSON-encoded SignatureAppearance object, sent as a form field value.

position.description: JSON-encoded StampPosition object, sent as a form field value.

index.description: Page index, 0-based — the value to send as StampPosition.page.

widthPts.description: Page width in PDF points (1/72 inch) in user space. Stamp coordinates are in this space, so this is the number to do stamp arithmetic against.

heightPts.description: Page height in PDF points in user space.

rotation.description: Page /Rotate, normalised to 0, 90, 180 or 270. A non-zero value means a top-left or pixel rectangle cannot be converted for this page — send user-space points instead.

displayWidthPts.description: Width of the box a viewer displays: swapped with the height when rotation is 90 or 270. A pixel rectangle measured over a rendered page is relative to this box.

displayHeightPts.description: Height of the box a viewer displays. See displayWidthPts.

sizeBytes.description: Size of the uploaded PDF in bytes.

pageCount.description: Number of pages. 0 when the document is encrypted and could not be read.

pages.description: Per-page geometry, in document order. Empty when encrypted.

encrypted.description: True when the PDF is password-protected. Such a document cannot be signed — reject it at upload and ask for an unprotected copy.

signatureCount.description: Existing signature dictionaries found anywhere in the file, including earlier incremental revisions. Non-zero means the document was signed before; signing again is legitimate but is rarely intended for what an app treats as a fresh upload.

signable.description: Whether this document can be submitted to POST /api/v1/sign as-is.

InspectResponse.description: What the server can determine about an uploaded PDF without modifying it. Nothing is stored: the document is parsed in memory and discarded with the response.

pdf.description: The PDF to inspect. Rejected with 413 above the server MAX_UPLOAD_MB limit.

get.description: Unauthenticated. Use for container health checks and load-balancer probes.

post.summary: Read a PDF page geometry without modifying it
post.description:
Returns the page count, the size of every page in PDF points, and each page /Rotate —
the facts a client needs before it can build a `position` for POST /api/v1/sign at all.
Call this first: inspect, place, sign.

Also reports whether the document is encrypted (this service cannot sign a
password-protected PDF) and how many signatures it already carries, which are the two
reasons to reject an upload before a user has filled anything in.

Read-only. The uploaded document is parsed in memory and discarded with the response —
nothing is stored, modified or signed.

200.description: What the server could determine about the document.

400.description: No PDF part was sent (MISSING_FILE), or the upload could not be parsed as a PDF (INVALID_PDF). An encrypted PDF is NOT an error here — it returns 200 with `encrypted: true` so the caller can explain the rejection.

413.description: The uploaded PDF exceeds the server MAX_UPLOAD_MB limit (PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE).

post.summary: Sign a PDF with the server certificate
post.description:
Applies an optional visible stamp and then a PKCS#7/CMS detached signature, using the
PKCS#12 certificate configured on the server (P12_PATH / P12_PASSWORD). The stamp is
rendered *before* hashing, so the stamp pixels fall inside the signed ByteRange and any
later modification is detectable in Adobe Acrobat Reader.

Because the body is multipart/form-data, `metadata`, `appearance` and `position` are sent
as form field values containing JSON — a string per field, not a nested object part.
`position` is required whenever `appearance` is present; omit both to produce an
invisible cryptographic-only signature.

`position` defaults to PDF points with a bottom-left origin. A rectangle taken from a
browser is neither, so declare the space it was measured in — `origin: "top-left"`,
`units: "px"`, `viewportWidth: <rendered page width>` — and the server converts it
against the real page geometry. The rectangle finally used comes back in X-Stamp-Rect.
Call POST /api/v1/documents/inspect first for the page sizes.

schema.description: Hex SHA-256 of the concatenated ByteRange segments. Recompute it from the returned PDF and X-Byte-Range to verify the response independently.

X-Document-Hash.description: Hex SHA-256 of the concatenated ByteRange segments. Recompute it from the returned PDF and X-Byte-Range to verify the response independently.

schema.description: JSON array [offset1, length1, offset2, length2] — the signed byte spans. The gap between them is the /Contents hex slot, which is not signed.

X-Byte-Range.description: JSON array [offset1, length1, offset2, length2] — the signed byte spans. The gap between them is the /Contents hex slot, which is not signed.

schema.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp embedded in the signature.

X-Signing-Time.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp embedded in the signature.

schema.description: Present only when a stamp was applied. JSON object {page, x, y, width, height} giving the rectangle actually drawn, in PDF points with a bottom-left origin, after any origin/units conversion. Compare it against what your UI drew to confirm placement without re-parsing the PDF.

X-Stamp-Rect.description: Present only when a stamp was applied. JSON object {page, x, y, width, height} giving the rectangle actually drawn, in PDF points with a bottom-left origin, after any origin/units conversion. Compare it against what your UI drew to confirm placement without re-parsing the PDF.

400.description: Bad request: no PDF part (MISSING_FILE), a field failed validation (VALIDATION_ERROR, with per-field `details`), the PDF could not be parsed (INVALID_PDF), the stamp was rejected (INVALID_APPEARANCE / INVALID_POSITION / MISSING_POSITION), or the signature did not fit the placeholder (SIGNATURE_OVERFLOW).

413.description: The uploaded PDF exceeds the server MAX_UPLOAD_MB limit (PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE).

500.description: Server-side failure: certificate could not be loaded (INVALID_CERTIFICATE), the ByteRange invariant failed (BYTE_RANGE_ERROR), or an unexpected error (INTERNAL_ERROR).
